business_scope.primary_industry_name: Physical Wholesale Brokerage of Marine Fuel Oil and Distillates

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (codified) with Islamic Sharia as a principal source of legislation, commercial matters governed by Law No. 4 of 2018 and specialized investment regulations

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Law No. 80 of 2002 on Combating Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing, as amended by Law No. 36 of 2014, with Executive Regulations under Decree No. 17 of 2003; Central Bank of Egypt AML/CFT Mandatory Rules; Law No. 4 of 2018 on Companies (UBO register obligations); GAFI Resolution No. 14 of 2019 prescribing UBO disclosure forms

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified passport copies of all ultimate beneficial owners
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport authority or notary public in the country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing for each corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Home-jurisdiction company registry (e.g., UK Companies House, UAE Ministry of Economy)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter confirming source of funds for each UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Financial institution in the UBO's jurisdiction

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all applicants, directors, and UBOs against the Egyptian Ministry of Interior anti-terrorism list, Central Bank of Egypt consolidated AML/CFT blacklist, UN Security Council Consolidated List, OFAC SDN List, and EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List; enhanced due diligence required for politically exposed persons (PEPs) including source-of-wealth report, senior-management approval, and 5-year record retention; any negative hit automatically suspends incorporation until clearance is obtained from the Ministry of Interior or the sanctioning authority.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) Electronic Services – 'Invest in Egypt' Portal (https://www.gafi.gov.eg)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: All Egyptian company names must be in Arabic; a Latin transliteration is permitted for cross-border trading purposes and must correspond phonetically to the Arabic name. Latin-only names are allowed only for foreign company branches and must exactly match the parent company's registered name.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Names identical or phonetically similar to an existing registered company
'Oil', 'Petroleum', 'Gas', 'Energy' unless accompanied by the applicable license from the Ministry of Petroleum and Mineral Resources
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: A name reservation may be renewed for two additional 30-day periods (total maximum 90 days). If GAFI rejects the proposed name, the applicant may file a written administrative appeal with GAFI's Legal Affairs Department within 15 days of rejection notice. GAFI must issue a reasoned decision within 30 days. Further judicial appeal is available before the Administrative Court of the Administrative Judiciary Council under Law No. 106 of 2013. No new name application may be filed until the appeal is resolved or the rejection is formally withdrawn.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not permissible as a statutory registered office for an LLC engaged in physical wholesale energy commodity trading. Law No. 4 of 2018 requires a physical office in Egypt with active management and commercial records. A virtual office may be used only for incidental correspondence, not for the registered head office or for obtaining an energy-trading license.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: High – quantified risk of unannounced physical on-site inspection is assessed at 75% within the first two years of registration because the entity is classed as High-Risk Special License by the Central Bank and will be subject to oversight by GAFI, the Financial Regulatory Authority, and the Ministry of Petroleum inspectors.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: GAFI company name reservation and clearance fee
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory fee under Law No. 4 of 2018, Article 12 and GAFI tariff schedule

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Statutory printing and notarization of Arabic Memorandum of Association and Articles of Association
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Egyptian Notary Public Authority (Ministry of Justice)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Notary tariff per page – minimum set for 20-page corporate set

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Consular legalization of foreign due-diligence documents (3 documents: passport copy, good-standing certificate, bank reference)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Egyptian Ministry of Foreign Affairs and the competent Egyptian consulate abroad
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Consular legalization fee per document, approximately USD 150

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: UBO register initial setup and AML/CFT compliance manual
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed Egyptian law firm / AML compliance consultant
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark for a high-risk trader with up to 50 UBOs

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: GAFI commercial registry registration fee for LLC
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory fee calculated on the issued capital (minimum nominal capital) plus incidental e-filing fee

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Publication of incorporation notice in Al-Waqa'i Al-Misriya (Egyptian Gazette)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Official journal publication tariff for corporate notices

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Companies Law No. 159 of 1981 (as amended), Articles 6, 33–58 (Limited Liability Companies); Investment Law No. 72 of 2017 and its Executive Regulations No. 2310/2017; Commercial Registration Law No. 34 of 1976 and Executive Regulations.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) – Investor Service Center / Companies Registration Department, in coordination with the Commercial Registry of the Ministry of Trade and Industry.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Notarized Articles of Association (Aqd al-Ta'sis) and the GAFI Standard Incorporation Application for an LLC.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital is fixed for an LLC under Law 159/1981 as amended; the subscribed capital must be paid in full at incorporation either in cash deposited in a licensed Egyptian bank (bank deposit certificate required) or in kind supported by an audited asset valuation.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED: that the first board of managers (the Undersigned Founding Members) (i) subscribe in full to the capital of the limited liability company set out in the Company Contract and acknowledge payment of all contributed amounts; (ii) adopt and record the Company’s registered office at the address stated in the Contract; (iii) appoint [Full name, National ID] as General Manager and [Full name] as Alternate Manager, each with individual and joint signatory powers over bank accounts, regulatory filings, and licensing applications; (iv) authorize the General Manager to finalize the GAFI incorporation dossier, procure the commercial registration and tax card, and certify this resolution as valid without further meeting.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Pre-incorporation name reservation and capital bank escrow certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: GAFI Investor Service Center (online 'E-Services' portal) and a licensed Egyptian bank.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Access the GAFI online portal, reserve a unique company name in Arabic and/or English, then open a temporary bank account in the name of the proposed LLC in a licensed Egyptian bank and deposit the subscribed capital. Obtain a bank certificate of capital deposit and a shareholders’ contribution schedule.
required_dossiers: Founding members' national IDs or passports
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused due to similarity, request administrative reconsideration within 15 days and submit a distinctive name declaration; if bank delays the deposit certificate, escalate in writing to the bank's compliance officer and, if necessary, to the Central Bank of Egypt consumer protection unit.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and notarization of the LLC company contract
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed Egyptian notary public, with legal counsel admitted to the Egyptian Bar.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the Arabic Company Contract and annexes (shareholders' list, capital allocations, manager appointments) in accordance with Law 159/1981. Ensure the corporate objects expressly cover wholesale trading of crude oil, refined petroleum products, marine fuel oil, and distillates. Execute the contract before a notary public, pay notarial fees, and obtain certified original copies.
required_dossiers: Object statement (wholesale trading in petroleum products)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary refuses authentication due to contradictory clauses, amend the contract to comply with mandatory LLC provisions, reconvene the subscribers, and re-notarize within seven days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing incorporation application with GAFI one-stop shop
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: GAFI – Companies Registration Department / One-Stop Shop.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the full incorporation dossier physically at the GAFI One-Stop Shop or through a licensed online filing account. Pay the prescribed government fees (approximately USD 150 for LLC registration plus notarial costs) and obtain a GAFI receipt and tracking number. GAFI verifies compliance and issues the certificate of incorporation/completion notice.
required_dossiers: Declaration of lawful activity in petroleum products
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If GAFI raises an objection, submit written clarification or amended documents; appeal to the GAFI Appeals Committee under Investment Law Article 95 within 30 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Commercial Registry of the Ministry of Trade and Industry; Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After GAFI approval, register the LLC in the Commercial Register at the competent commercial registry office and obtain the commercial registration number. Then apply to the Egyptian Tax Authority for a Tax Identification Number (TIN) and collect the tax card.
required_dossiers: Lease or ownership evidence of registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Commercial Registry issues a query, rectify the identified document deficiency within ten working days; if the ETA rejects the TIN application due to an outdated address, file a written objection with updated lease evidence and obtain a channeled approval.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Publication and legal ga evidenced mechanics
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: GAFI, Commercial Registry, and the Official Gazette (Al Jaridah Al Rasmiyah).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: If statutory publication is required for the LLC object statement, arrange publication in the Official Gazette. Update the GAFI file with the commercial registration number and pay the gazette fees; prepare a formal share transfer ledger and bank mandate card.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the gazette refuses publication because the company object is too broad, resubmit a clarified scope of activity and pay republication fees.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-formation internal governance and statutory books
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of managers; external auditor where required.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Hold the first organizational meeting to approve the pro-forma board resolution, open the operational corporate bank account, issue share certificates, adopt the corporate seal, and create statutory books (shareholders' ledger, minutes book, inspection book) required by Law 159/1981.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank refuses account opening due to insufficient beneficial ownership documentation, supplement the file with accurate beneficial ownership declarations and resubmit to the bank's compliance officer.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministry of Petroleum and Mineral Resources – Petroleum Products Sector / Egyptian General Petroleum Corporation (EGPC) – Oil Trading and Distribution Licensing Committee.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Petroleum Products Trading License for Wholesale Marine Fuel Oil and Distillates under Law No. 20 of 1976 authorizing the holding, transporting, and trading of petroleum products.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Egyptian Environmental Affairs Agency (EEAA) – Ministry of Environment
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category B (limited EIA) – environmental screening required for wholesale trading, storage, and marine fuel logistics; full Category A EIA becomes mandatory if onshore tank storage or refinery-coupled processing is undertaken.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Compliance with Law No. 4 of 1994 and Executive Regulations; wastewater discharges to public sewer must meet Decree No. 44/2000 – pH 6–9, oil and grease ≤ 15 mg/L, BOD ≤ 60 mg/L, COD ≤ 100 mg/L, TSS ≤ 60 mg/L; fugitive VOC emissions from loading/transfer operations must be controlled to the limits of Decree No. 338/1995 with no uncontrolled venting; spill prevention and hazardous waste handling plans must meet the Hazardous Waste Management Regulation standards.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification from the Civil Defense Authority (General Directorate of Civil Defense, Ministry of Interior); structural load stability inspection certificate from the municipal engineering directorate; workplace occupational safety and health clearance under Ministry of Manpower Law No. 12 of 2003 (as amended) and implementing Decree No. 211/2016; for bunkering activities, an approved emergency response plan and spill containment procedure are required.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA), Ministry of Finance — official e-services and e-filing portal: https://www.eta.gov.eg; e-invoicing API host: https://einvoice.invoicing.eta.gov.eg; export customs clearance is supervised by the Egypt Customs Authority under the same Ministry.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign-owned LLC obtains its statutory Tax Identification Number (TIN) through the GAFI one-stop-shop: (1) notarized Articles of Association; (2) GAFI incorporation certificate; (3) commercial registry entry; (4) ETA unified registration application filed electronically within 30 days of incorporation, followed by ETA verification of the registered seat, local bank account, and the appointed tax representative; (5) issuance of the electronic tax card containing the unified TIN. A non-resident company that establishes a permanent establishment in Egypt must complete the same registration within 30 days of commencing its Egyptian activity.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation — an Egyptian LLC is a resident juridical person taxed under Income Tax Law 91/2005 on worldwide profits at 22.5% CIT; downstream petroleum wholesale/brokerage profits remain in the standard CIT regime unless the entity is incorporated inside a GAFI/SCZONE free-zone facility, in which case a 1%–3% annual fee on turnover replaces CIT and VAT (special zone treatment). Dividends remitted to a foreign shareholder expose the LLC to 10% withholding (treaty-reduced), and no pass-through recognition is available.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No US-style check-the-box and no domestic hybrid-mismatch election exists in Egypt. Available elections: (i) free-zone status under Investment Law 72/2017 — annual fee of 1% (warehousing/wholesale) or 3% (services) of turnover in lieu of CIT/VAT; (ii) consolidated tax filing for an Egyptian parent holding at least 95% of Egyptian subsidiaries (Law 91/2005, Art. 53 bis, with ministerial approval); (iii) investment-incentive deduction of 30%–50% of qualifying capital expenditures listed under Investment Law 72/2017 and its regional implementation maps; (iv) optional application of the 40.55% petroleum tax rate under production-sharing contract frameworks (E&P only). Five-year loss carryforward is automatic.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) — Law No. 67 of 2016 as amended by Law No. 171/2022, with a separate schedule (table) duty applicable to certain domestically supplied petroleum products; exported petroleum products are outside the schedule duty.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: EGP 500,000 annual taxable supplies (mandatory threshold); registration filing is due within 60 days of the end of the month in which cumulative taxable supplies cross the threshold; imports of any value are subject to VAT at customs without a registration threshold.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory real-time e-invoicing (and e-receipts for B2C sales) for VAT registrants: the taxpayer must connect its local billing environment to the ETA's e-invoicing API, issue invoices in the ETA JSON/XML schema, sign each invoice with the ETA-certified digital certificate, and transmit the invoice to the ETA clearance engine within 24 hours of issuance; only ETA-cleared invoices (bearing a unique invoice ID, QR code, and digital signature) are admissible for input-VAT deduction and export zero-rating substantiation. No physical stamping or paper pre-certification remains.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of crude oil and refined petroleum products (ISIC 4661) are zero-rated under Art. 14 of Law 67/2016 when: the exporter holds a valid ETA tax card and an EGPC/General Authority of Petroleum export authorization naming the goods and quantity; the goods physically leave Egypt within 180 days of the invoice date; the bill of lading names an Egyptian port of loading and a foreign discharge port; the export proceeds are received in foreign currency through an Egyptian licensed bank; and the corresponding export customs declaration is accepted and closed by Egypt Customs. Offshore brokerage services for marine fuel supplied to non-resident principals are zero-rated as exported services when the contract, negotiation, and benefit of the service are located abroad and the commission is remitted from outside Egypt.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (final closed 'exit' copy) issued by Egypt Customs Authority
Original Bill of Lading (or Airway Bill) evidencing physical departure from Egypt
Inward Remittance Certificate / SWIFT credit advice showing receipt of foreign-currency proceeds into the exporter's Egyptian bank account
Commercial invoice and underlying export contract (purchase order / sale confirmation)
EGPC / General Authority of Petroleum export authorization for the specific petroleum product and quantity
Accredited marine surveyor's quality-and-quantity certificate plus terminal loading certificate
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: ETA export audits may reopen files for five years from the filing date; if any mandatory document is absent, forged, or the 180-day repatriation deadline is missed, the sale is re-characterised as a domestic supply: 14% VAT is assessed retroactively with a 2% monthly delay fine and an evasion penalty of up to 50% of the under-assessed tax (Law 191/2022), and deliberate document falsification carries imprisonment up to 5 years. The exporter is also suspended from the ETA zero-rated exporter list and referred to the Central Bank of Egypt and EGPC for license revocation.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Egypt (CBE) — البنك المركزي المصري, constituted under Law No. 88 of 2003 (Central Bank, Banking Sector and Monetary System Law, as amended). The CBE is the sole regulator of foreign-exchange operations, banking licensing, capital movements and payment-system rails inside Egypt; the General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) registers foreign investment and certifies capital inflows under Investment Law No. 72 of 2017, while the Egyptian Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing Combating Unit (EMLCU) operates as the national financial-intelligence unit for AML/CFT screening of cross-border wires.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Since the March 2024 exchange-rate unification and the CBE-led liberalization under the IMF Extended Fund Facility arrangement, the EGP functions as a bank-mediated managed float. Current-account convertibility — import settlement, freight, insurance, marine-fuel procurement and commissions — is operational through licensed banks subject to presentation of underlying contracts, invoices, shipping documents and E-Invoice/E-Receipt tax records; bona fide trade payments do not require central quantitative pre-approval. Capital-account convertibility remains restricted: foreign shareholders must register the investment with GAFI and effect the transfer through an Egyptian bank, while dividend repatriation and post-liquidation proceeds require audited financial statements, Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) clearance, Social Insurance clearance, and CBE-compliant banking codes evidencing the original inward investment. Practical hurdles for a fuel-wholesale trading LLC are: (i) banks enforce stricter documentary review and purpose-code verification for energy-trading flows; (ii) during USD-liquidity cycles (as experienced in 2022-2024), FX queues on dividend remittances may arise; and (iii) profit distribution is permitted in EGP equivalent unless the bank is satisfied with the USD earning evidence — treasury planning should therefore maintain a 2-4 week USD settlement buffer and parallel EGP liquidity lines.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Under the unified post-2024 regime, no mandatory conversion ratio into EGP applies — exporters may retain export receipts in foreign-currency accounts at an Egyptian bank. The statutory repatriation rule (CBE implementing instructions in force as of 2025) requires 100% of export proceeds to be credited to the exporter's Egyptian bank account through banking channels within 60 days of the bill-of-lading or airway-bill date; for bulk energy commodities, marine fuels and refined petroleum products, an extension to 180 days is obtainable through the handling bank where the letter-of-credit tenor, long-dated incoterms or demurrage schedules justify it. External collection through offshore accounts, offset, barter, or trade-for-debt arrangements is generally prohibited absent an express CBE Governor exemption; non-compliance exposes the exporter to suspension of export-document processing, loss of foreign-exchange access, and AML penalties.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account + Operating EGP/USD Current Account
Capital Escrow Account + Operating EGP/USD Current Account
Operating Multi-Currency (EGP/USD/EUR) Account + Trade Finance/LC Facilities
Operating Multi-Currency Account + Global Trade and Receivables Finance / SWIFT GPI
Operating USD Current Account + Standby LC / Documentary Credit Desk

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: Low-to-Medium. Legal constraints: CBE Law No. 88 of 2003, the CBE e-money licensing decree of 2020 and the Central Bank prohibition on unlicensed digital-payment intermediation require all EGP and export-import settlement rails to pass through a licensed Egyptian bank; offshore digital EMIs (Wise, Payoneer, Airwallex, Dukascopy-type) cannot lawfully hold trade proceeds for the Egyptian LLC, serve as the FX disbursement node, or evidence customs/tax-relevant payment flows. Their permissible auxiliary role is confined to group-level treasury sub-ledgers of the non-resident parent with onward SWIFT wiring into Egypt; the LLC's statutory treasury records must rely solely on bank statements issued by Egyptian supervised banks.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Mandatory enhanced due diligence applies to the energy wholesale sector (ISIC 4661). The LLC's authorized directors and every beneficial owner holding 25% or more (direct or indirect) must attend an in-branch KYC interview with the bank's compliance officer; remote video-only onboarding is not accepted for a high-risk commodity-trading entity. A non-resident director may be excused from physical appearance only upon delivery of an apostilled or consular-legalized notarized power of attorney, certified board resolutions and certified passport copies, while the designated Egyptian-resident signatory must appear in person; at least one managing director should appear physically during the first year of the banking relationship.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-risk sector red-flag: wholesale trading of marine fuel oil and refined products may conceal ship-to-ship (STS) transfers, trade with sanctioned jurisdictions, or customs-duty evasion.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Evidence bundle: Ministry of Petroleum and Mineral Resources commercial license or authorization confirming the wholesale/marine-fuel trading mandate; GAFI investment certificate; executed supply or brokerage agreements with licensed major offtakers (including EGPC-affiliated entities or recognized international trading houses); complete OFAC/EU/UN sanctions-screening reports for all counterparties and vessels; charter-party and bill-of-lading trail for each physical cargo; board-approved internal sanctions-compliance policy and written EDD undertakings.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: UBO opacity: multi-layered offshore parent chain, nominee shareholders, or bearer instruments concealing ultimate control of the Egyptian LLC.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified UBO declaration on CBE template identifying individuals owning more than 25% through attribution; group-organogram chain-of-control diagram endorsed by the external auditor; apostilled/legalized certificates of incorporation for each intermediate holding entity; certified shareholder registers and passport copies; negative declaration on bearer shares; board undertaking to notify the bank within 15 days of any ownership or control change.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Source-of-wealth/funds insufficiency: initial equity injection from unexplained crypto-asset gains, offshore shell profits, third-party funds, or informal hawala/dingdong correspondent channels.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified bank statements of each subscriber covering the 24 months preceding the investment; tax-residence certificates of investors; notarized statements of the economic source of funds; GAFI-approved capital-injection schedule; SWIFT wire strictly from the subscriber's own account with direct-investment purpose code; explicit prohibition of third-party benefactor funding; audit-firm confirmation of fund traceability to the escrow account.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Suspicious turnover pattern: thin-margin, high-volume broker flows with rapid collect-and-pay cycles may be mischaracterized as round-tripping, shadow lending or invoice-mill activity.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Detailed business plan with projected cargo volumes; executed master supply and brokerage agreements evidencing economic substance; Egyptian Tax Authority E-Invoice/E-Receipt activation certificates for full auditability; monthly open-receivables/payables reconciliation against bank statements; on-demand submission of invoices, bills of lading and customs declarations; charter or tank-storage agreements demonstrating operational capacity.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant protocol: (1) the foreign shareholder registers the equity investment with GAFI and obtains an investment certificate under Investment Law No. 72 of 2017; (2) the Egyptian LLC opens a Capital Escrow Account at the licensed bank and files the GAFI certificate, commercial-registry extract, tax card and E-Invoice activation proof; (3) the shareholder remits capital by SWIFT MT103/MT202 exclusively from its own bank account with the purpose code 'Direct investment — equity participation in Egyptian LLC', referencing the LLC name, GAFI registration number and escrow account number; (4) the receiving bank verifies payer-name match against the GAFI certificate and issues an inward-investment deposit certificate; (5) following full Commercial Registry activation and capital verification, the escrow balance is released into the operational account for energy-contract disbursements. Cash, traveller cheques, crypto assets and third-party EVS transfers are unacceptable.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Settlement architecture: (i) SWIFT MT103 with SWIFT GPI tracking is the rail for operating expenses, commissions, freight, insurance and intercompany services, supported by CBE-approved foreign-transfer purpose codes and E-Invoice references; (ii) documentary Commercial L/Cs, sight or usance, cover crude-oil and refined-product cargo purchases, with each drawing presenting the commercial invoice, full-set original bills of lading, certificate of quality and quantity (SGS/Intertek or equivalent), and certificate of origin; (iii) Standby Letters of Credit (SBLC) secure performance, demurrage and take-or-pay obligations to terminals, charterers and bunker suppliers; (iv) domestic EGP disbursements clear through the CBE RTGS (EGP Money Payment System) for customs, logistics and local operating costs, while USD/EUR supplier payments are executed as SWIFT transfers only after posting of the underlying import/export documentation, consistent with the bank's FX-rationing controls.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable USD/EGP FX forward contracts (tenors 1-12 months) concluded with the Egyptian licensed bank, limited to genuine underlying trade exposures and prohibited for speculative positions
FX swaps (spot-start or forward-start) for temporary exchange of EGP liquidity against USD trade-funding positions
Cross-currency interest rate swaps (CCIRS) aligning USD trade-finance floating-rate liabilities with USD/EGP cash-flow dynamics

Offshore NDF overlays are not permissible at the Egyptian LLC level; only the non-resident group parent may, subject to internal treasury policy, execute external USD/EGP NDF hedges that create no onshore EGP obligations

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual corporate income tax return and audited financial statements
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 4 months of the fiscal year-end; standard 31 December year-end requires filing by 30 April
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Monthly late-payment surcharge of 1.5% on assessed tax; fixed statutory fines for late filing under Law No. 91/2005; ETA may suspend tax clearance, freeze bank accounts, and refer the company to compulsory enforcement. Continued failure to file may cause GAFI to classify the entity as inactive and initiate administrative strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Approved annual financial statements and shareholders' resolution approving accounts
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) Companies Registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 6 months of the fiscal year-end, followed by submission to the registry within 10 days of shareholder approval
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fines under Companies Law No. 159/1981 for late filing; two consecutive years of non-filing may result in an administrative strike-off notice published by GAFI, with deregistration after the warning period.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual quota-holder list and updated beneficial owner confirmation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: GAFI Commercial Registry in coordination with the AML/CFT Unit
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually within 30 days of the financial statement approval date and immediately on any transfer of LLC quotas
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Unregistered quota transfers are ineffective against third parties; AML Law No. 80/2002 penalties apply for false or missing UBO disclosures, with fines up to EGP 200,000 and potential suspension of the commercial registration.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual commercial registration certificate and local business license renewal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Commercial Registration Office, Ministry of Trade and Industry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on the registration anniversary, with renewal ordinarily required before 31 December to avoid interruption in January
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-renewal penalty of EGP 100 per month; registration suspension after 3 months may trigger loss of the petroleum trading license and administrative strike-off for continued inactivity.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Renewal of petroleum products wholesale brokerage and marine fuel trading license
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Ministry of Petroleum and Mineral Resources / Egyptian General Petroleum Corporation (EGPC), coordinated through GAFI
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually before the license expiry date, commonly aligned with the commercial registration anniversary or 31 December calendar-year renewal cycle
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Operating without a renewed license results in administrative closure, EGPC port and supplier blacklisting, revocation of the commercial registration, and potential criminal liability for unauthorized petroleum trading.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 1 month after the close of the tax year, reconciling all monthly withholding tax filings for the preceding 12 months
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Monthly 1.5% delay surcharge on unpaid withholding tax, statutory late-filing fines, and suspension of the entity's tax card which blocks customs clearance, bank transactions, and governmental tender participation.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory for all Egyptian LLCs; no turnover, capital, or revenue exemption in force. Companies in petroleum wholesale and marine fuel brokerage must always appoint a licensed Egyptian auditor and submit audited financial statements with the ETA under Law No. 91/2005 and Companies Law No. 159/1981.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Egyptian Accounting Standards (EAS), which are substantially aligned with IFRS; financial statements must be presented in EGP and audited by an auditor licensed by the Egyptian Federation of Accountants and Auditors.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Under GAFI AML Law No. 80/2002 and implementing regulations, the LLC must maintain a current beneficial ownership register. Any quota transfer requires updating the UBO register and notifying the Commercial Registry before the transfer is perfected. Annually, the legal representative or registered agent must file a UBO confirmation statement certifying current beneficial owners and percentage holdings, even if no share transfer occurred during the year.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Minutes of General Assembly and Board Meetings

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: US$1,500 - US$6,000 depending on transaction volume and petroleum-trading AML risk profile

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No general tax holiday for wholesale commodity-brokerage LLCs. Law No. 30 of 2023 (effective for tax periods commencing on or after 1 January 2024) retains the 22.5% headline CIT rate. Preferential measures are limited: Investment Law No. 72 of 2017 projects in designated governorates and SCZone may claim an investment-cost deduction of up to 50% of capital expenditure; inter-corporate dividends are exempt where participation conditions are met; petroleum-sector upstream producers are taxed under concession rates, which do not apply to trading intermediaries. Tax losses are carried forward for a maximum of five years.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Corporate Income Tax Return Form No. 19 (juridical persons) filed electronically through the Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) e-filing portal at www.eta.gov.eg; a signed paper copy with supporting schedules must be retained for inspection and submission on ETA demand.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within four months after the end of the fiscal year (for a 31 December year-end: on or before 30 April). The final tax liability is payable by the same deadline; provisional instalments are paid during the year by companies registered with the Large Taxpayer Centre.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross revenue from wholesale brokerage of crude oil, refined products and marine fuel, including commissions and any trading margin.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the full contractual commission value without netting buy-side costs; retain trade confirmations, bills of lading, SWIFT messages and letters of credit as evidentiary support.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 2 - Cost of goods sold and direct expenses
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Cargo cost, inspection, freight, hedging costs and directly attributable brokerage expenses.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Deduct only invoice-supported costs from Egyptian or treaty-resident suppliers; payments to non-resident related parties must satisfy the arm's-length test and are subject to 20% WHT if they constitute taxable services.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Statutory taxable profit after disallowances, depreciation, the EBITDA-based interest limitation and five-year loss carryforward relief.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Reconcile book profit to tax profit; related-party interest above the statutory limitation and non-deductible expenses must be added back.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Schedule of all cross-border related-party transactions, values, transfer-pricing method applied, commission mark-up and comparability indicators.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Identify each non-resident counterparty and contract value; attach the Local File where annual transactions exceed EGP 25 million and the Master File where group revenue exceeds EGP 1 billion.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration of amounts withheld on payments to non-residents: interest and royalties at 20%, dividends at 10% and service fees at 20%, with treaty rates applied where authorized.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Attach the tax residence certificate and treaty-relief authorization for each reduced-rate payment; without a valid TRC the statutory WHT rate applies.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: administrative fine of EGP 500-2,000 per return; late payment: 2% monthly surcharge on the unpaid tax from the due date, capped at 100% of the tax. Non-filing triggers an ETA estimated assessment and publication of the taxpayer's name; fraudulent non-filing is referred to the criminal court and may result in imprisonment.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: The non-resident shareholder obtains a Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) from its home tax authority, has it apostilled where applicable and officially translated into Arabic, and submits it with a treaty-relief application to the ETA International Taxation Department before or at the time of distribution. The ETA verifies beneficial ownership and shareholding, then issues a reduced-withholding authorization; the Egyptian LLC withholds at the treaty rate from the first remittance and attaches the authorization to the WHT voucher. Treaty dividend rates generally range from 5% to 15% depending on the ownership percentage and the applicable DTA.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties for intellectual property: statutory 20%, treaty-reduced typically 10%-20%. Interest on foreign debt: statutory 20%, treaty-reduced typically 10%-15% subject to beneficial-ownership certification. Technical, consulting and management fees paid to non-residents are treated as Egyptian-source service income and subject to 20% WHT with treaty reduction available.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Local File mandatory where annual cross-border related-party transactions exceed EGP 25,000,000; Master File mandatory where the multinational group's consolidated revenue exceeds EGP 1,000,000,000; Country-by-Country Report notification applies at the same EGP 1 billion group-revenue threshold, per Ministerial Decree No. 788 of 2016 as amended by Decree No. 427 of 2023.
